import json, copy
from pipeline import import_batch, resume
from reducer import empty_state
from checkpoint import dump_state, load_state
from codec import parse_event

# Complex scenario with unicode/pipes/whitespace IDs, split reserve, reuse, replay.
events = [
    {'id': 'e1', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'A B', 'qty': 10},
    {'id': 'e2', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'caf\u00e9|x\\y', 'qty': 5},
    {'id': 'e3', 'op': 'reserve', 'request': 'req #1', 'lines': [['caf\u00e9|x\\\\y', 2], ['A B', 2], ['caf\u00e9|x\\\\y', 1]]},
    {'id': 'e4', 'op': 'cancel', 'request': 'req #1'},
    {'id': 'e5', 'op': 'reserve', 'request': 'req #1', 'lines': [['A B', 3]]},
    {'id': 'e3', 'op': 'reserve', 'request': 'req #1', 'lines': [['A B', 2], ['caf\u00e9|x\\\\y', 3]]},  # replay old
]
texts = [json.dumps(e, ensure_ascii=False) for e in events]

# uninterrupted
unint = import_batch(empty_state(), texts)
unint_dump = dump_state(unint)

# restart at each boundary
accum = dump_state(empty_state())
for i in range(1, len(texts)+1):
    accum = resume(accum, [texts[i-1]])
    assert accum == dump_state(import_batch(empty_state(), texts[:i])), 'boundary %d mismatch' % i
assert accum == unint_dump, 'final mismatch'
print('restart equivalence: OK')
print('final checkpoint:', accum)
print('final stock:', load_state(accum)['stock'])
print('final requests:', load_state(accum)['requests'])

# caller preservation: import_batch must not mutate input state
src = {'stock': {'X': 7}, 'requests': {'q': {'X': 2}}, 'seen': {'s1': parse_event(json.dumps({'id':'s1','op':'restock','sku':'X','qty':1}))}}
snap = copy.deepcopy(src)
try:
    import_batch(src, ['garbage'])
except ValueError:
    pass
assert src == snap, 'input mutated'
print('failed batch caller preservation: OK')
"
